$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (hermiq-ai-tooling, design D8). One agent_action object per call of a curated agent tool: who asked (agent), for whom (grantingUser), what, and what came of it. A staged batch is the record whose outcome is staged; phase 2 names it in proposal. Admin-only, like the dead letters it points at. Written by lib/Service/AgentTools/AgentActionStore.php.

agent_action.title: Agent action
agent_action.summary: One call of an agent tool, with the agent, the user it acted for and the outcome
agent_action.description: Written for every call of an integriq agent tool, also a refused one. A batch that waits for approval is kept here until a person approves it in Hermiq.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The tool the agent called, for example integriq.replayDeadLetters.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The agent that called the tool, as Hermiq names it.

grantingUser.title: On behalf of
grantingUser.description: The user the agent acted for. The action check ran as this user.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: denied by the action check, staged and waiting for approval, refused at approval, executed, or failed.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why a call was denied, refused or failed.

store.title: Target kind
store.description: What the target ids are: a synchronization, sync dead letters or event dead letters.

targetIds.title: Targets
targetIds.description: The ids the call was about. Never their content.

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: The hash that ties an approval to exactly this batch.

proposal.title: Batch
proposal.description: The staged batch a later call refers to.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: The Hermiq approval the agent presented.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: The person who approved the batch in Hermiq.
